source_census.discovery: src/hooks/use-network-capture.ts installs a MAIN-world tap only after Start on the already loaded document. Its Reload action stops capture and destroys the tap; it does not capture document-start requests on reload.
source_census.selection: src/features/showcase/tabs/NetworkTab.tsx lists captured responses append-only without URL/body deduplication; choosing an event pins that response and defaults to exact URL and body. A transient request can therefore be selected even after the page route settles into a different search mode. In this run the three manual-capture responses included only one OpenAI response, whose params showed prefixLast; no settled prefixNone response was offered before save.
source_census.replay: src/lib/data-pattern/document-network-capture.ts installs the tap before reload, while src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts correctly requires the saved exact body digest. This discovery/replay timing asymmetry exposes the mismatch on sites whose request semantics change as the route settles.

remaining: No product repair or end-to-end acceptance is claimed.
